name: Mendocino Ridge
terms: American Viticultural Area. A wine labeled with one must take at least 85% of its grapes from that area.

notes: The warm inland part of the county makes full bodied, very ripe reds from Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Petite Sirah and Zinfandel.

blurb.text: A coastal AVA in Mendocino County made up only of ridge tops at or above ⟦elev|1,200 feet|370 m⟧, roughly the fog line. Its boundary runs along the southern Mendocino coast from the Navarro River to the Sonoma County line.
